newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian union boss dies in bomb blast.
newsitem.headline: Colombian union boss dies in bomb blast.

text.p: A hospital workers' union leader died and four other people, including two policemen, were injured in a twin bomb blast at a hospital in southwest Colombia on Tuesday, police said.
Hector Galindez was killed instantly in the first explosion, which occurred in his office at a hospital in Yumbo, near Cali, Colombia's second largest city.
Two policemen and two members of the regional prosecutor's department were wounded by a secondary device, which detonated in the office, as they went to investigate.
"We are checking to see if the bombs were planted in the office or if Galindez had actually been making the bombs," a Cali police spokesman said.

The explosions come less than a week after a massive car bomb exploded in the northwest town of Apartado, in the trouble-torn banana-growing region of Uraba, killing 11 people and wounding more than 50 others.
